tools.name: find_agencies
tools.description: Find licensed insurance agencies that write a line of insurance (general liability, workers' comp, commercial auto, bonds, property, home, auto, life, health and more) in a US state, for someone who wants an insurance quote. Returns every matching agency in the DouxProcess network, best match first,

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search the free insurance MCP directory by line of insurance, US state, who it is for, or words. Each result says whether the server answered its last live check (every 30 minutes), its tool count and its address.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Everything about one listed server: its tools from the last live check, its address and how to add it to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok.

tools.name: build_my_server
tools.description: How an insurance agency gets its own MCP server, free: the builder link and what it makes.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
